$description: Procedural textures. Every texture is a pure function of (seed, params) so it renders identically every time.

watercolor.use: Fill under ink lines; the fill deliberately misses the line by a few px.

halftone.use: Treatment for photos/footage. Duotone: ink-or-thread on paper.

stipple.use: Treatment for portraits; dissolves into particles on exit (Dunkirk reel).

halo.use: Soft glow ring behind key points (GraduateML reel).

ripple.use: Concentric rings from the motif when it is named (POE reel).
